source.title: FAU Simple Syllabus Library
source.robots_finding: One logical GET to the canonical root URL redirected through /ui/locale-redirect?/robots.txt to /en-US/robots.txt (HTTP 302, 302, 200). The final text disallows all paths only for GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, and ChatGPT-User. The identified SmartAdvisorSyllabusCollector/1.0 HTTP client and the clean browser's native Chrome user agent do not match those named tokens. That observation does not establish authorization to automate collection or redistribute documents.
source.access_finding: The anonymous library listed these exact documents. Direct manifest-link navigation and library initialization followed by the same exact link both left an empty JavaScript shell; the browser-generated essential document request returned HTTP 403. No login redirect or visible sign-in/access-denied message appeared, so this is a generic anonymous access denial of unknown policy cause, not proof of an explicit login requirement. No login, credentials, private API construction, or bypass was used.
source.redistribution_finding: No redistribution license was identified. This tracked manifest contains identifiers and public page URLs only; complete documents and extracted text are excluded.

selection_rule: Three exact Fall 2026 sections overlapping the five-course description sample; no term or section substitution.
